## Personality

Jane Andrews is a steady, sensible, and unflappable individual whose conscientious and plodding nature earned her top honors in domestic science. She is motivated by a strong desire to devote her entire life to teaching rather than ever marrying.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## History

Jane Andrews participated in a dramatic reenactment of Elaine alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Ruby, which went awry when their flat began to leak. Later, she accompanied [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) alongside [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md), joining [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) for supper on the drive home. After leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), Jane visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her boarding house along with [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) and Ruby, bringing news that an Avery scholarship was available. As spring examinations approached, Jane and her classmates anxiously prepared for their tests while discussing commencement attire.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. > — Jane Andrews — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P2](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0002)

>
> — Jane Andrews — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P8](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0008)
